parts.t: Welcome to #53 – 19897 75A Avenue, a modern and move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhouse in the sought-after Mayfair at West Village community in
Built in 2022, this spacious 1,462 sq ft home offers a bright, open-concept layout with premium finishes throughout.
Willoughby remains one of Langley’s growing communities

, driven by consistent demand for family-sized townhomes with modern layouts, attached garages, and access to parks, schools, and shopping. This 4-bedroom townhome offers strong value for buyers seeking additional space compared to typical 3-bedroom units.
With rapid population diversification and multiple new urban developments underway, Willoughby has become a top destination for families, investors, and commuters.
The local townhome market continues to benefit from low supply relative to demand, especially for larger floorplans above 1,600 sq. ft.
Buyers prioritize open-concept main levels, updated appliances, EV-ready garages, and energy-efficient heating systems.
Strong walkability to schools and shopping corridors such as 200 Street and Willoughby Town Centre further enhances long-term value.
Properties in this segment have demonstrated resilient pricing, making them a reliable asset class within Langley’s housing market.

The main floor features wide-plank flooring, oversized windows, and a stylish kitchen complete with KitchenAid stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, a large island, and gas cooking—perfect for families and entertainers alike. Enjoy year-round comfort with forced-air heating, central A/C, and on-demand hot water.

Upstairs, you'll find three well-appointed bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet and spa-like ensuite featuring double sinks and a frameless glass shower. A full second bathroom and laundry area complete the upper level. A fourth bedroom or flex space on the lower level offers the perfect setup for a home office, guest room, or playroom, and is adjacent to a convenient powder room.
